candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 because its downstream call to order (POST /v1/orders) returns 500. Traces and logs show the gateway's client request to order failing with 500, propagating as 502 on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause within order service (db, redis, config) not established; only the order 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Gateway 502s on /v1/checkout are caused by the order service returning 500 on POST /v1/orders, as shown in traces and logs. The specific fault inside order is not yet evidenced, so the bounded candidate is the propagated http-500 from order.
missing_evidence: Order service traces/logs showing the internal failure causing its 500 response
Order service metrics for dependency operations (postgresql, payment, inventory) outcomes
Order service error logs or stack traces at the failing request time
